journey.name: wear remove wallet
journey.description:
Confirming Remove wallet deletes the wallet from the watch: onboarding opens, a restart stays on onboarding, and the encrypted seed file is gone. Emulator and physical watch (`run-as` works on any debug build).
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet. Backend: hosted regtest. The journey leaves no wallet; restore one again for the journeys that need it.

actions.action: Run `adb shell run-as to.bitkit.dev ls no_backup/seed` and verify it lists one file, the encrypted seed
Swipe the pager left: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Verify onboarding again: "WatchOnboardingRestore" is listed and "WatchHomePager" is not
Run `adb shell run-as to.bitkit.dev ls no_backup/seed` and verify it prints nothing: the encrypted seed is deleted
